title: Rams expect both Puka Nacua, Alaric Jackson to play against 49ers in Australia despite off-field incidents

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams expect both Puka Nacua, Alaric Jackson to play against 49ers in Australia despite off-field incidents
sources.description: Puka Nacua was sued by a woman after several allegations this past offseason, and Alaric Jackson was arrested in June but not charged after a domestic violence incident.
